book_titles.interpretation: Raw title remains the real full title. The independent display_title is a compact candidate used only after native full-title overflow in the existing single-line slots. Actual visible 020/030-derived numeric identities, current-book IDs and pointer-origin/full-data identity remain independently recorded. Complete raw titles or optional compact prefixes are not required in every narrow display slot.
book_titles.source_text_role: Static existing contract only; it does not grant rendered-glyph acceptance.

light_capabilities.interpretation: Only the actually exposed frontlight/warmth controls are qualified. No implemented auto-brightness capability is declared, so a fake actionable sample row is not manufactured. Actual supported content determines sheet height and reader-bar attachment. Static review does not grant physical auto-brightness or slider-operation success.

same_case_artwork.interpretation: The same-case source/crop/order/processed/oracle chain and three actually viewed closed originals remain separate from native-panel review. Closed originals contain artwork only and no observed app chrome. Hidden hit regions, hardware, old different-page oracles and full-round behavior receive no screenshot credit.
